English (Original):
Clubs which developed young players will now receive a small percentage of any future transfers involving those players for he duration of their career.

Example:
If Brighton sell Bobby Zamora to Ipswich and then several years later he is sold onto Arsenal for £10,000,000, Brighton would receive a percentage of the £10,000,000 transfer fee.

This rule is meant to protect small clubs from larger clubs poaching their players and also to encourage the development of players by smaller clubs.

Genç oyuncuları yetiştiren kulüpler, artık bu oyuncuların kariyerleri boyunca gerçekleşecek gelecekteki transferlerinden küçük bir yüzde alacak.

Örnek:
Brighton, Bobby Zamora'yı Ipswich'e satarsa ve birkaç yıl sonra oyuncu Arsenal'e £10,000,000 karşılığında transfer olursa Brighton da £10,000,000 tutarındaki transfer bedelinden pay alacak.

Football's Governing body has announced that due to legal difficulties with the existing transfer regulations within the European Union the existing transfer system has been modified.

The main changes include:

* Clubs guaranteed compensation for training young players
* Maximum Contract length is now 5 years
* Players only bound to a contract for 3 years (under 28) or 2 years (over 28)

It is believed that these changes will result in an improved and fairer transfer system for both players and clubs.

Başlıca değişiklikler:

* Genç oyuncuları yetiştiren kulüpler için tazminat güvencesi
* Azami sözleşme süresi artık 5 yıl
* Oyuncuların sözleşmeyle bağlı kalacağı süre 28 yaş altındakiler için 3 yıl, 28 yaş üstündekiler için 2 yıl
